Hi Laura,

Quick question as we're evaluating Redwood for a short pilot: does Redwood require a minimum monthly commit for the hosted API, or do you offer a purely pay-as-you-go option for pilot customers? Hi Sam — thanks for reaching out. Short answer: we support both pay-as-you-go and committed tiers for the hosted API. Longer answer with options below so you can pick what fits the pilot. Attaching our current Q1 rate card for reference.

High-level options (hosted API):
- Pay-as-you-go: no upfront commit, billed per-token/embedding unit. Good for short ad-hoc pilots but unit costs are ~higher than commit pricing.
- Short-term pilot commit (1–3 months): minimum $5k/month recommended for predictable burst handling; includes a one-time $2k pilot credit if signed within 30 days.
- Standard commit bands (annual or quarterly): $15k+/month qualifies for tiered discounts and extended SLA options.

Embeddings vs generation: embeddings are billed on a different unit price (per-embedding) and typically see lower per-unit costs; commits can be split across product types but pricing differs.

If you'd like, I can propose three concrete structures (pilot, small production, and scale) and loop in Ben from sales/finance for discount approvals. Want me to send that?

Best,
Laura
Laura Bennett

Hi Sam — following up with concrete packaging options so you can share with your team / procurement. Per our internal alignment (cc Ben):

Option A — No commit (Pay-as-you-go)- No minimum; standard pay-as-you-go rates apply. Good for exploratory testing but higher unit cost. No pilot credit.

Option B — Short pilot commit (recommended for POC)- Term: 1–3 months- Minimum: $5,000 USD / month- Pilot credit: $2,000 one-time credit applied to first invoice if signed within 30 days- Included: 2 Console seats, 3 months of request log retention, onboarding call with Solutions Engineering- Conversion path: 30-day notice; can convert to quarterly or annual commit with credited usage applied toward first commit.

Option C — Quarterly commitment (best for small production)- Term: 3 months minimum, billed monthly or upfront- Minimum: $12,000 USD / month- Discount: standard commit tier discounts; for CloudScale I can offer a promotional 10% off the first quarter (requires signature + PO)

Notes on discounts: Per Ben, we can provide a one-time promotional discount for first-period commitments; anything beyond that requires a finance approval. I have attached a clean SOW template and the rate card for reference.

Next steps: if procurement is OK with Option B pilot at $5k/mo, please send a PO referencing Deal RDW-3479 and we'll draft the SOW and activate the pilot within 48 business hours.

Best,
